rationale: B wins because it treats the holes as assignment-killers, not garnish: “Without the numerator/denominator, this angle cannot be pitched” is the kind of sentence that saves a founder from embarrassing themselves. A has good bones, but “Substack is building a TikTok-style feed without the ad model” turns an unproven business-model inference into the headline. B still overreaches with the Mailchimp/YouTube frame, so this is not a clean victory; it is the better messy draft.
gaps_in_A: “Substack is building a TikTok-style feed without the ad model” is not grounded in the update. The facts say Substack takes a 10% subscription cut; they do not say there are no ads or that the feed is funded only that way.
“Substack's feed is funded by a 10% cut of paid subscriptions” is too confident. That is exactly the thing a reporter would have to verify, not the thing the angle gets to assume.
“its revenue is capped at 10% of subscriptions” overstates the fact block. The update gives a take rate, not a complete revenue model.
A misses the strongest human-protagonist angle B finds: what native video and a TikTok-style feed do to writers who joined a writing platform. That is not a rephrase; it is a different desk.
gaps_in_B: “Substack has stopped competing with Mailchimp and started competing with YouTube” is a kept angle built on outside comparison. The update supports category shift; it does not establish those competitors.

“the people who chose Substack precisely because it was text now face a feed that rewards something they didn't sign up to make” is useful but asserted too hard. The update does not say the feed rewards video or that text-only writers lose distribution.

“venture-backed consumer platforms” is not in the supplied facts. Privately held with funding struggles is enough; adding venture-backed color without evidence is how a finance reporter starts sharpening knives.
“Next step: journalist-fit-check” is a half-step premature. The top-creator definition, gross-vs-net question, and funding-history citation need fact-checking before names go anywhere near this.
